Write an XML profile to JSON or YAML

write_xml_profile.Rd

Discover structural evidence and define a reviewable, reusable extraction contract. Proposals and XSD evidence are advisory rather than silently executable.

Usage

write_xml_profile(
profile,
file,
format = c("auto", "json", "yaml"),
overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

profile

An xml_profile or compatible profile object.

file

Destination JSON or YAML file.

format

Serialization format. "auto" infers it from the destination extension.

overwrite

Logical; whether an existing destination may be replaced.

See also

xml_profile(), rectangle_xml()
